incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A scene of collapsed buildings with debris scattered on the ground, showing significant structural damage.

observations.description: A multi-story building is completely collapsed, with walls and roof reduced to rubble.
A tall, partially intact pole stands near the debris pile.
A green tree is visible in the background, behind the rubble.
Large white sack is visible in the foreground.
